```plato
//==
// # Rigid dynamics
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Rigid-body dynamics
//  - Forces, impulses, and gravitation
//  - The solver view of a body
//  - Simulation worlds

//==
// # Rigid-body dynamics
//
// Mass properties, rigid-body state, surface materials, and simulation
// stepping parameters. Linear quantities are in meters, kilograms, and
// seconds; angular quantities are in radians.

// A zero-based index of a body within an external body array (the simulation
// world's body list). -1 means "none" / "the static environment".
type BodyIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

//==
// # Motion kind and mass properties

// How a body participates in dynamics: never moves (Static), is moved
// externally and treated as infinitely massive (Kinematic), or integrates
// forces and impulses (Dynamic).
type BodyMotion = Static | Kinematic | Dynamic;

// The inertial properties of a planar rigid body: total mass, center of mass
// in the body's local frame (meters), and the scalar moment of inertia about
// the out-of-plane axis through the center of mass.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Center_of_mass)
type MassProperties2D
    implements IValue
{
    Mass: Mass;
    CenterOfMass: Point2D;
    MomentOfInertia: MomentOfInertia;
}

// The inertial properties of a spatial rigid body: total mass, center of mass
// in the body's local frame (meters), and the inertia tensor about the center
// of mass in body space, in kilogram-square-meters.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moment_of_inertia)
type MassProperties3D
    implements IValue
{
    Mass: Mass;
    CenterOfMass: Point3D;
    InertiaTensor: SymmetricMatrix3x3;
}

//==
// # Rigid bodies

// A planar rigid body. LinearVelocity is in meters per second; LinearDamping
// and AngularDamping are exponential velocity decay rates in units of one per
// second (0 = none); GravityScale is a dimensionless multiplier on world
// gravity (1 = normal, 0 = unaffected).
type RigidBody2D
    implements IValue
{
    Pose: Pose2D;
    LinearVelocity: Vector2D;
    AngularVelocity: AngularVelocity;
    MassProperties: MassProperties2D;
    Motion: BodyMotion;
    LinearDamping: Number;
    AngularDamping: Number;
    GravityScale: Number;
}

// A spatial rigid body. LinearVelocity is in meters per second;
// AngularVelocity is in radians per second about each world axis;
// LinearDamping and AngularDamping are exponential velocity decay rates in
// units of one per second (0 = none); GravityScale is a dimensionless
// multiplier on world gravity (1 = normal, 0 = unaffected).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rigid_body_dynamics)
type RigidBody3D
    implements IValue
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    LinearVelocity: Vector3D;
    AngularVelocity: Vector3D;
    MassProperties: MassProperties3D;
    Motion: BodyMotion;
    LinearDamping: Number;
    AngularDamping: Number;
    GravityScale: Number;
}

//==
// # Materials

// How two touching bodies' material coefficients merge into one contact
// coefficient.
type MaterialCombine = Average | Min | Max | Multiply;

// ISurface response properties of a body. StaticFriction and DynamicFriction
// are dimensionless Coulomb coefficients; Restitution is the bounciness in
// [0, 1]; the combine kinds say how the two touching materials' values merge.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friction)
type PhysicsMaterial
    implements IValue
{
    StaticFriction: Number;
    DynamicFriction: Number;
    Restitution: Proportion;
    FrictionCombine: MaterialCombine;
    RestitutionCombine: MaterialCombine;
}

//==
// # Simulation settings

// When a dynamic body is allowed to fall asleep: both velocity magnitudes
// must stay below their thresholds for at least TimeToSleep.
type SleepSettings
    implements IValue
{
    LinearThreshold: Speed;
    AngularThreshold: AngularVelocity;
    TimeToSleep: Duration;
    Enabled: Boolean;
}

// Fixed-step integration parameters: the fixed step FixedDeltaTime is divided
// into Substeps sub-integrations; VelocityIterations and PositionIterations
// are constraint solver iteration counts; MaxStepsPerFrame caps catch-up
// stepping when the render frame runs long.
type TimeStepSettings
    implements IValue
{
    FixedDeltaTime: Duration;
    Substeps: Integer;
    VelocityIterations: Integer;
    PositionIterations: Integer;
    MaxStepsPerFrame: Integer;
}
```
